name: Raygun
summary: Raygun Crash Reporting sells error volume in blocks. Basic is $40 a month on annual billing for 100,000 errors, Team is $80 for 200,000, and Business at $400 covers 1 million errors and includes SAML single sign-on. Every plan has unlimited members.

facts.text: Raygun groups errors by stack trace by default, can group by message alone for client-side JavaScript, and accepts a custom grouping key.
Deployment tracking flags releases that add new errors and can confirm whether a fix worked.
Error data is kept for 180 days on Basic, Team and Business.
Errors above the reserved volume are billed on demand at $0.001 each on both annual and monthly billing.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Billed annually; $60 on monthly billing. SAML single sign-on is an add-on

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Billed annually; $600 on monthly billing. SAML single sign-on included

hiddenCosts: SAML single sign-on on Basic is a paid add-on, and the pricing page did not list it for Team.
Real user monitoring and application performance are priced separately from Crash Reporting.

security.ssoPlan: Business and Enterprise; add-on on Basic
